sections.prompt: Take one sentence you wrote recently and say how you would make it shorter and clearer.

sections.title: Learning objectives
sections.lede: These are the three things you will be able to do by the end of the lesson.

sections.title: The big picture
sections.lede: Formal writing improves when cohesion, precision and register work together.

blocks.text: Cohesion means the text holds together. Use pronouns and connectors to link sentences: “Diese Maßnahme … Sie … Aus diesem Grund …”. Avoid repeating the same noun in every sentence, and make sure each connector expresses the right relationship.

Precision means replacing vague verbs such as “machen” or “haben” with specific ones: “durchführen”, “gewährleisten”, “ermöglichen”. Register means choosing formal, impersonal forms where appropriate: “Es wird empfohlen” rather than “Ich finde, du solltest”.

blocks.title: Edit in three passes
blocks.text: First edit structure, then sentences, then words. Trying to fix everything at once makes the text worse, not better.

sections.title: Rules & patterns
sections.lede: The patterns to keep in mind while you work through the examples.

rows: Diese Maßnahme … Sie … Aus diesem Grund …

items: Replace “sehr wichtig” with a specific reason or consequence.
Keep sentences under about 20 words in formal writing.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.lede: Listen once, then read the example aloud.

items.example: Der Zusammenhang zwischen Kosten und Qualität ist klar.
items.exampleEn: The connection between cost and quality is clear.

items.example: Die Kohärenz des Textes leidet unter den vielen Wiederholungen.
items.exampleEn: The coherence of the text suffers from the many repetitions.

items.example: Könnten Sie Ihre Aussage bitte präzisieren?
items.exampleEn: Could you please make your statement more precise?

items.example: Ich muss den Bericht noch überarbeiten.
items.exampleEn: I still need to revise the report.

sections.title: Example sentences
sections.lede: Notice how the pattern behaves in a complete sentence.

items.de: Aus den genannten Gründen befürworte ich die Maßnahme.
items.en: For the reasons mentioned, I support the measure.
items.note: A formal conclusion with a clear stance.

items.de: Die Maßnahme wurde im letzten Jahr durchgeführt.
items.en: The measure was implemented last year.
items.note: Durchführen is more precise than machen.

items.de: Es wird empfohlen, den Prozess zu vereinfachen.
items.en: It is recommended to simplify the process.

items.de: Diese Entwicklung hat mehrere Ursachen. Eine davon ist der Fachkräftemangel.
items.en: This development has several causes. One of them is the shortage of skilled workers.
items.note: A short sentence with a clear link.

sections.title: Pronunciation
sections.lede: Short, focused sound work. Play each item and repeat it twice.

blocks.text: German formal writing values clarity and structure, but it also tolerates longer noun phrases than English. The goal is not to sound complicated; it is to be precise and easy to follow.
Nominal style (“die Durchführung der Maßnahme”) is common in reports. Too much of it becomes heavy. A good text mixes noun phrases with clear verbs.

sections.title: Dialogue in context
sections.lede: Read the scene, then play it and follow the speakers.
sections.setting: Two colleagues review a draft report.

lines.speaker: Leiterin
lines.de: Der Text ist zu lang. Können wir ihn kürzen?
lines.en: The text is too long. Can we shorten it?

lines.speaker: Autor
lines.de: Ja, ich ersetze die Wiederholungen durch Pronomen.
lines.en: Yes, I will replace the repetitions with pronouns.

lines.speaker: Leiterin
lines.de: Und bitte präzisieren Sie den letzten Absatz.
lines.en: And please make the last paragraph more precise.

lines.speaker: Autor
lines.de: Gern. Ich überarbeite den Bericht bis morgen.
lines.en: Gladly. I will revise the report by tomorrow.

sections.title: Grammar spotlight
sections.heading: Editing checklist
sections.lede: Check structure, then sentences, then words.

rows: Does each paragraph have one purpose?
Do the connectors express the right relationship?
Can a vague verb be replaced?
Is the tone appropriate for the audience?

blocks.text: Nominalisations can hide the actor: “Die Durchführung erfolgt durch das Team.” If the actor matters, use the active voice: “Das Team führt die Maßnahme durch.”

sections.tip: Read the text aloud. Long, tangled sentences are easier to hear than to see.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence has formal, impersonal register?
options: Ich finde, du solltest das machen.

exercises.explanation: Es wird empfohlen is impersonal and formal.

sections.lede: Type the missing word or ending. Spelling counts.

exercises.explanation: Befürworten means to support or advocate.

exercises.prompt: Es wird ___, den Prozess zu vereinfachen.

exercises.explanation: Präzisieren means to make more precise.

sections.title: Build the sentence
sections.lede: Click the words in the order that makes a correct German sentence.

exercises.prompt: Build: “For the reasons mentioned, I support the measure.”
exercises.answer: Aus den genannten Gründen befürworte ich die Maßnahme.
exercises.explanation: The fronted prepositional phrase is followed immediately by the verb.

exercises.prompt: Build: “The measure was implemented last year.”
exercises.answer: Die Maßnahme wurde im letzten Jahr durchgeführt.
exercises.explanation: The passive puts the participle at the end.

exercises.prompt: Build: “It is recommended to simplify the process.”
exercises.answer: Es wird empfohlen, den Prozess zu vereinfachen.
exercises.explanation: The impersonal passive is followed by the zu-infinitive.

sections.title: Listening
sections.lede: Listen twice before you look at the transcript.
sections.speaker: Feedback zu einem Bericht

script.speaker: Leiterin
script.de: Der Bericht ist inhaltlich gut, aber sprachlich zu lang.
script.en: The report is good in content, but linguistically too long.

script.speaker: Leiterin
script.de: Ja, und bitte präzisieren Sie die Empfehlung am Ende.
script.en: Yes, and please make the recommendation at the end more precise.

script.speaker: Autor
script.de: Verstanden. Ich überarbeite den Text bis Freitag.
script.en: Understood. I will revise the text by Friday.

sections.title: Speaking
sections.lede: Record or say your answer aloud, then compare it with the model.
sections.prompt: Rewrite a vague sentence into precise, formal German and explain your change.

model.de: Statt „Wir machen das Projekt besser“ schreibe ich: „Wir optimieren die Projektabläufe, um die Durchlaufzeit zu verkürzen.“ Das ist präziser und formaler.
model.en: Instead of “We are making the project better”, I write: “We are optimising the project processes in order to shorten the throughput time.” That is more precise and more formal.

tips: Replace one vague verb with a specific one.
Add a purpose clause with um … zu.
Read the sentence aloud to check its length.

sections.title: Common mistakes
sections.lede: These are the errors learners most often make with this pattern.

items.why: Durchführen is the precise verb for implementing a measure.

items.wrong: Ich finde, dass das besser ist.
items.right: Es wird empfohlen, den Vorschlag anzunehmen.
items.why: Formal writing often prefers impersonal constructions.

items.wrong: Die Maßnahme wurde durchgeführt von uns im letzten Jahr.
items.right: Die Maßnahme wurde im letzten Jahr durchgeführt.
items.why: The agent is usually omitted in formal passive writing.
